# categorize cardiovascular-related HCPCS/CPT codes
# based on the ranges you listed in the conversation

def _cv_category(code):
    if pd.isna(code):
        return None
    s = str(code).strip()
    # C‑codes for assorted devices
    if s.startswith("C"):
        try:
            n = int(s[1:])
        except ValueError:
            return None
        if 2617 <= n <= 2631:
            return "Assorted Cardiovascular and Genitourinary Devices"
        return None
    # numeric codes (most CPT/HCPCS are numeric)
    try:
        n = int(s)
    except ValueError:
        return None

    # defined cardiovascular ranges with descriptive labels
    ranges = [
        (92920, 92998, "Therapeutic Cardiovascular Services and Procedures"),
        (93000, 93153, "Cardiography Procedures"),
        (93150, 93153, "Phrenic Nerve Stimulation System"),
        (93224, 93278, "Cardiovascular Monitoring Services"),
        (93279, 93298, "Implantable, Insertable, and Wearable Cardiac Device Evaluations"),
        (93303, 93356, "Echocardiography Procedures"),
        (93451, 93598, "Cardiac Catheterization Procedures"),
        (93600, 93662, "Intracardiac Electrophysiological Procedures/Studies"),
        (93668, 93668, "Peripheral Arterial Disease Rehabilitation"),
        (93701, 93790, "Non-invasive Physiologic Studies and Procedures"),
        (93792, 93793, "Home and Outpatient International Normalized Ratio (INR) Monitoring Services"),
        (93797, 93799, "Other Cardiovascular Procedures"),
    ]
    for lo, hi, label in ranges:
        if lo <= n <= hi:
            return label
    return None

# apply to the dataframe

df["CARDIOVASCULAR_CATEGORY"] = df["HCPCS_CODE"].apply(_cv_category)
# binary flag for any cardiovascular entry

df["IS_CARDIOVASCULAR"] = df["CARDIOVASCULAR_CATEGORY"].notna().astype("Int8")

# quick sanity check: codes beginning with 92/93 that weren't labeled

unmatched = df["HCPCS_CODE"].loc[
    df["HCPCS_CODE"].astype(str).str.match(r"^(92|93)") & df["IS_CARDIOVASCULAR"].eq(0)
].unique()

print("unmatched codes starting with 92/93:", sorted(unmatched)[:20])
print("total CV rows", df["IS_CARDIOVASCULAR"].sum())

# show distribution by category
print(df.groupby("CARDIOVASCULAR_CATEGORY").size().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10))

# CARDIO: monthly activity by code (claims-weighted, memory-safe)

monthly_code_claims = (
    df.loc[df["IS_CARDIOVASCULAR"].eq(1), ["CLAIM_FROM_MONTH", "HCPCS_CODE", "TOTAL_CLAIMS"]]
      .groupby(["CLAIM_FROM_MONTH", "HCPCS_CODE"], observed=True)["TOTAL_CLAIMS"]
      .sum()
      .reset_index(name="TOTAL_CLAIMS_SUM")
)

monthly_code_claims["CLAIM_MONTH"] = pd.to_datetime(
    monthly_code_claims["CLAIM_FROM_MONTH"].astype(str),
    format="%Y-%m",
    errors="coerce",
)

# fallback for any mixed formats
if monthly_code_claims["CLAIM_MONTH"].isna().any():
    monthly_code_claims["CLAIM_MONTH"] = pd.to_datetime(
        monthly_code_claims["CLAIM_FROM_MONTH"],
        errors="coerce",
    )

monthly_code_claims = monthly_code_claims.dropna(subset=["CLAIM_MONTH"]).sort_values(
    ["HCPCS_CODE", "CLAIM_MONTH"]
)

MAX_CODES_TO_PLOT = 15
code_totals = monthly_code_claims.groupby("HCPCS_CODE")["TOTAL_CLAIMS_SUM"].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
codes_to_plot = code_totals.index.tolist() if MAX_CODES_TO_PLOT is None else code_totals.head(MAX_CODES_TO_PLOT).index.tolist()
plot_df = monthly_code_claims.loc[monthly_code_claims["HCPCS_CODE"].isin(codes_to_plot)].copy()

all_cv_codes = sorted(monthly_code_claims["HCPCS_CODE"].unique())
palette = sns.color_palette("tab20", n_colors=max(20, len(all_cv_codes))).as_hex()
color_map = {code: palette[i % len(palette)] for i, code in enumerate(all_cv_codes)}
color_map["93306"] = "red"

plt.style.use("ggplot")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 7))

for code in codes_to_plot:
    s = plot_df.loc[plot_df["HCPCS_CODE"].eq(code)]
    ax.plot(
        s["CLAIM_MONTH"], s["TOTAL_CLAIMS_SUM"],
        marker="o", linewidth=1.8, markersize=3.5,
        label=code, color=color_map.get(code),
    )

ax.set_title("Cardiovascular Code Total Claims per Month")
ax.set_xlabel("Claim Month")
ax.set_ylabel("Total Claims")
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda x, pos: f"{x:,.0f}"))
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%Y-%m"))
ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=90)
if not plot_df.empty:
    ax.set_xlim(plot_df["CLAIM_MONTH"].min(), plot_df["CLAIM_MONTH"].max())
ax.margins(x=0)
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.25)
ax.legend(title="HCPCS Code", bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc="upper left", frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

top5_cardio_claims = code_totals.head(5).rename("TOTAL_CLAIMS_SUM").reset_index()
top5_cardio_claims

cv = df.loc[df["IS_CARDIOVASCULAR"].eq(1), ["CLAIM_FROM_MONTH", "HCPCS_CODE", "TOTAL_PAID"]].copy()
cv["HCPCS_CODE"] = cv["HCPCS_CODE"].astype(str)
cv["TOTAL_PAID"] = pd.to_numeric(cv["TOTAL_PAID"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)

# CLAIM_FROM_MONTH is typically YYYYMM (example: 201802)
cv["CLAIM_MONTH"] = pd.to_datetime(cv["CLAIM_FROM_MONTH"].astype(str), format="%Y%m", errors="coerce")
if cv["CLAIM_MONTH"].isna().any():
    cv["CLAIM_MONTH"] = pd.to_datetime(cv["CLAIM_FROM_MONTH"], errors="coerce")

monthly_code_paid = (
    cv.dropna(subset=["CLAIM_MONTH"])
      .groupby(["CLAIM_MONTH", "HCPCS_CODE"], as_index=False)["TOTAL_PAID"]
      .sum()
      .rename(columns={"TOTAL_PAID": "TOTAL_PAID_SUM"})
      .sort_values(["HCPCS_CODE", "CLAIM_MONTH"])
)

monthly_code_paid["TOTAL_PAID_MILLIONS"] = monthly_code_paid["TOTAL_PAID_SUM"] / 1_000_000

# set to None to plot all cardiovascular codes; keep a cap for readability by default
MAX_CODES_TO_PLOT = 15
code_totals = monthly_code_paid.groupby("HCPCS_CODE")["TOTAL_PAID_MILLIONS"].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

plot_df = monthly_code_paid.loc[monthly_code_paid["HCPCS_CODE"].isin(codes_to_plot)].copy()

# consistent code->color mapping (same logic in both charts), with 93306 fixed to red
all_cv_codes = sorted(monthly_code_paid["HCPCS_CODE"].unique())
palette = sns.color_palette("tab20", n_colors=max(20, len(all_cv_codes))).as_hex()
color_map = {code: palette[i % len(palette)] for i, code in enumerate(all_cv_codes)}
color_map["93306"] = "red"

plt.style.use("ggplot")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 7))

for code in codes_to_plot:
    s = plot_df.loc[plot_df["HCPCS_CODE"].eq(code)]
    ax.plot(
        s["CLAIM_MONTH"],
        s["TOTAL_PAID_MILLIONS"],
        marker="o",
        linewidth=1.8,
        markersize=3.5,
        label=code,
        color=color_map.get(code),
    )

ax.set_title("Cardiovascular Code Total Paid per Month")
ax.set_xlabel("Claim Month")

ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda x, pos: f"${x:,.1f}M"))
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%Y-%m"))

# remove extra left/right padding so lines start at first month
ax.set_xlim(plot_df["CLAIM_MONTH"].min(), plot_df["CLAIM_MONTH"].max())
ax.margins(x=0)

ax.grid(True, alpha=0.25)

# categorize neurology-related HCPCS/CPT codes
# ranges sourced from Codes.xlsx (Neuro sheet)

def _neuro_category(code):
    if pd.isna(code):
        return None
    s = str(code).strip()

    # numeric codes (most CPT/HCPCS are numeric)
    try:
        n = int(s)
    except ValueError:
        return None

    ranges = [
        (95700, 95811, "Sleep Medicine Testing and Long-term EEG Procedures"),
        (95812, 95830, "Routine Electroencephalography (EEG) Procedures"),
        (95829, 95836, "Electrocorticography"),
        (95836, 95857, "Range of Motion Testing"),
        (95860, 95872, "Electromyography Procedures"),
        (95873, 95887, "Ischemic Muscle Testing and Chemodenervation Guidance Procedures"),
        (95905, 95913, "Nerve Conduction Tests"),
        (95919, 95924, "Autonomic Function Testing Procedures"),
        (95925, 95941, "Evoked Potentials and Reflex Testing Procedures"),
    ]

    for lo, hi, label in ranges:
        if lo <= n <= hi:
            return label
    return None

# apply to the dataframe
df["NEUROLOGY_CATEGORY"] = df["HCPCS_CODE"].apply(_neuro_category)
# binary flag for any neurology entry
df["IS_NEUROLOGY"] = df["NEUROLOGY_CATEGORY"].notna().astype("Int8")

# quick sanity check: codes beginning with 95/96 that were not labeled
unmatched_neuro = df["HCPCS_CODE"].loc[
    df["HCPCS_CODE"].astype(str).str.match(r"^(95|96)") & df["IS_NEUROLOGY"].eq(0)
].unique()

print("unmatched codes starting with 95/96:", sorted(unmatched_neuro)[:20])
print("total neuro rows", df["IS_NEUROLOGY"].sum())

# show distribution by category
print(df.groupby("NEUROLOGY_CATEGORY").size().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10))

# Interrupted Time Series (ITS) across cardiovascular and neurology codes (claims only)
# Breakpoint: January 2021

import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm

BREAKPOINT = pd.Timestamp("2021-01-01")
MIN_PRE_MONTHS = 12
MIN_POST_MONTHS = 12
HORIZON_MONTHS = 12  # effect window (level + 12 * slope_change)

def run_its_by_code(monthly_df, value_col, code_col="HCPCS_CODE", date_col="CLAIM_MONTH"):
    work = monthly_df[[date_col, code_col, value_col]].dropna(subset=[date_col, code_col]).copy()
    work[date_col] = pd.to_datetime(work[date_col], errors="coerce")
    work = work.dropna(subset=[date_col])
    work[code_col] = work[code_col].astype(str)

    full_months = pd.date_range(work[date_col].min(), work[date_col].max(), freq="MS")
    if len(full_months) == 0:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    break_idx = np.searchsorted(full_months.values, BREAKPOINT.to_datetime64())
    if break_idx >= len(full_months):
        return pd.DataFrame()

    pre_n = int((full_months < BREAKPOINT).sum())
    post_n = int((full_months >= BREAKPOINT).sum())
    if pre_n < MIN_PRE_MONTHS or post_n < MIN_POST_MONTHS:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    t = np.arange(len(full_months), dtype=float)
    post = (full_months >= BREAKPOINT).astype(float)
    time_post = np.where(full_months >= BREAKPOINT, t - break_idx, 0.0)

    X = pd.DataFrame({
        "const": 1.0,
        "time": t,
        "post": post,
        "time_post": time_post,
    })

    rows = []
    for code, g in work.groupby(code_col, sort=False):
        y = (
            g.set_index(date_col)[value_col]
             .sort_index()
             .reindex(full_months, fill_value=0.0)
             .astype(float)
             .to_numpy()
        )

        # skip completely flat series
        if np.nanstd(y) == 0:
            continue

        fit = sm.OLS(y, X).fit(cov_type="HC3")
        b = fit.params
        p = fit.pvalues

        pre_mask = full_months < BREAKPOINT
        post_mask = full_months >= BREAKPOINT

        avg_level_before = float(np.nanmean(y[pre_mask])) if pre_mask.any() else np.nan
        avg_level_after = float(np.nanmean(y[post_mask])) if post_mask.any() else np.nan

        slope_before = float(b.get("time", np.nan))
        slope_delta = float(b.get("time_post", np.nan))
        slope_after = slope_before + slope_delta

        level_delta = float(b.get("post", np.nan))

        rows.append({
            "HCPCS_CODE": code,
            "avg_level_before": avg_level_before,
            "avg_level_after": avg_level_after,
            "level_delta": level_delta,
            "level_change_p_value": float(p.get("post", np.nan)),
            "slope_before": slope_before,
            "slope_delta": slope_delta,
            "slope_after": slope_after,
            "slope_change_p_value": float(p.get("time_post", np.nan)),
        })

    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if out.empty:
        return out

    return out.sort_values(["level_change_p_value", "slope_change_p_value"], ascending=[True, True]).reset_index(drop=True)

required_tables = {
    "Cardiovascular Claims": ("monthly_code_claims", "TOTAL_CLAIMS_SUM"),
    "Neurology Claims": ("monthly_neuro_claims", "TOTAL_CLAIMS_SUM"),
}

missing = [name for name, (tbl, _) in required_tables.items() if tbl not in globals()]
if missing:
    raise NameError(
        "Run the monthly aggregation cells first. Missing tables for: " + ", ".join(missing)
    )

its_results = {}
for label, (tbl_name, value_col) in required_tables.items():
    its_df = run_its_by_code(globals()[tbl_name], value_col=value_col)
    its_df.insert(0, "analysis", label)
    its_results[label] = its_df

# Combined report ordered by lowest level change p-value, then slope change p-value
its_all = pd.concat(its_results.values(), ignore_index=True)
its_all = its_all.sort_values(["level_change_p_value", "slope_change_p_value"], ascending=[True, True])

print("Top 30 ITS results ordered by lowest level_change_p_value then slope_change_p_value (claims only):")
display(
    its_all.head(30)[[
        "analysis", "HCPCS_CODE",
        "avg_level_before", "avg_level_after", "level_delta", "level_change_p_value",
        "slope_before", "slope_delta", "slope_after", "slope_change_p_value"
    ]].style.format({
        "avg_level_before": "{:.2f}",
        "avg_level_after": "{:.2f}",
        "level_delta": "{:.2f}",
        "level_change_p_value": "{:.2e}",
        "slope_before": "{:.2f}",
        "slope_delta": "{:.2f}",
        "slope_after": "{:.2f}",
        "slope_change_p_value": "{:.2e}",
    })
)

for label, df_res in its_results.items():
    print(f"\n{label} - top 15 ordered by lowest level_change_p_value then slope_change_p_value")
    display(df_res.head(30)[[

# Plot the top 15 ITS codes (claims) for each analysis
# Assumes these already exist from your ITS cell:
# - its_results
# - monthly_code_claims
# - monthly_neuro_claims
# - BREAKPOINT

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.api as sm

TOP_N = 15

def plot_top_its_codes(monthly_df, its_df, label, value_col="TOTAL_CLAIMS_SUM", top_n=15):
    if its_df.empty:
        print(f"{label}: no ITS results to plot.")
        return

    top = its_df.head(top_n).copy()
    top_codes = top["HCPCS_CODE"].astype(str).tolist()

    work = monthly_df[["CLAIM_MONTH", "HCPCS_CODE", value_col]].copy()
    work["CLAIM_MONTH"] = pd.to_datetime(work["CLAIM_MONTH"], errors="coerce")
    work["HCPCS_CODE"] = work["HCPCS_CODE"].astype(str)
    work = work.dropna(subset=["CLAIM_MONTH"])

    full_months = pd.date_range(work["CLAIM_MONTH"].min(), work["CLAIM_MONTH"].max(), freq="MS")
    break_idx = np.searchsorted(full_months.values, BREAKPOINT.to_datetime64())
    t = np.arange(len(full_months), dtype=float)
    post = (full_months >= BREAKPOINT).astype(float)
    time_post = np.where(full_months >= BREAKPOINT, t - break_idx, 0.0)
    X = pd.DataFrame({"const": 1.0, "time": t, "post": post, "time_post": time_post})

    ncols = 3
    nrows = int(np.ceil(len(top_codes) / ncols))
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(nrows, ncols, figsize=(18, 4 * nrows), sharex=True)
    axes = np.array(axes).reshape(-1)

    for i, code in enumerate(top_codes):
        ax = axes[i]
        g = work.loc[work["HCPCS_CODE"].eq(code), ["CLAIM_MONTH", value_col]].sort_values("CLAIM_MONTH")
        y = g.set_index("CLAIM_MONTH")[value_col].reindex(full_months, fill_value=0.0).astype(float).to_numpy()

        fit = sm.OLS(y, X).fit(cov_type="HC3")
        yhat = fit.predict(X)

        p_level = top.loc[top["HCPCS_CODE"].eq(code), "level_change_p_value"].iloc[0]
        p_slope = top.loc[top["HCPCS_CODE"].eq(code), "slope_change_p_value"].iloc[0]

        ax.plot(full_months, y, marker="o", markersize=2.5, linewidth=1.2, label="Actual")
        ax.plot(full_months, yhat, linewidth=1.8, linestyle="--", label="ITS fit")
        ax.axvline(BREAKPOINT, color="black", linestyle=":", linewidth=1.2)
        ax.set_title(f"{code} | p_level={p_level:.3g}, p_slope={p_slope:.3g}", fontsize=10)
        ax.grid(True, alpha=0.25)
        ax.tick_params(axis="x", which="both", bottom=True, top=False, labelbottom=True)

    for j in range(len(top_codes), len(axes)):
        axes[j].axis("off")

    handles, labels = axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels()
    fig.legend(handles, labels, loc="upper right", bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 0.95), ncol=1, frameon=False)
    fig.suptitle(f"{label} — Top {len(top_codes)} ITS codes (claims)", y=0.98, fontsize=14)
    plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.92, 0.95])
    plt.show()

# Cardiovascular claims top 15
plot_top_its_codes(
    monthly_df=monthly_code_claims,
    its_df=its_results["Cardiovascular Claims"],
    label="Cardiovascular Claims",
    value_col="TOTAL_CLAIMS_SUM",
    top_n=TOP_N,
)

# Neurology claims top 15
plot_top_its_codes(
    monthly_df=monthly_neuro_claims,
    its_df=its_results["Neurology Claims"],
    label="Neurology Claims",
    value_col="TOTAL_CLAIMS_SUM",
    top_n=TOP_N,
)
